description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' source-generated serializers, verifying their correctness across various scenarios including class, record, and struct serialization, handling of object graphs with cycles, external types, array support, and more. It uses Xunit for testing and involves serialization, deserialization, and deep copy validation.

classes.name: GeneratedSerializerTests
classes.description: Test class for Orleans' source-generated serializers, containing multiple unit tests covering different serialization scenarios.

methods.name: RecursiveTypeSerializersRoundTripThroughCodec
